purpose: Persist the causal relation baseline execution receipt -> verified branch receipt -> promoted candidate checkpoint without giving the host or reference machine authority to select a branch automatically.

authority.numerical_verification: WASM Burn reference machine branch receipt

protocol.phase_1_begin: before mutation, beginPromotion validates the committed baseline host receipt, exact compact WASM branch receipt bytes, equivalent=true, state diff, candidate ProgramBundle digest and candidate program identity, then commits a pending intent
protocol.phase_2_commit: caller explicitly invokes CheckpointBranchSet.commitBranchByReceipt; this contract does not perform or authorize that selection
protocol.phase_3_complete: after mutation, completePromotion accepts only exact promoted ProgramBundle bytes and program identity matching the pending candidate and appends a completion event
protocol.crash_semantics: a crash or failure after begin but before complete leaves a durable pending intent and never implies that promotion succeeded

validation.baseline: must be a committed burn-research.host-execution-receipt.v2 for the same host subject and its exact state checkpoint/program identity must match the branch receipt baseline
validation.branch_receipt: must be exact compact burn-research.checkpoint-branch-verification.v1 bytes whose outer SHA-256 receipt digest reproduces, equivalent=true, promotion_authorized=false, and whose nested Burn verifier receipt is passing
validation.candidate: begin and complete both hash exact ProgramBundle bytes; the digest must equal candidate_state_checkpoint_bytes_sha256
validation.state_diff: baseline/candidate bundle digests must agree with the branch receipt and semantic_equivalence_asserted must remain false
validation.restart: all intent and completion IDs plus branch receipt bytes are revalidated on every ledger load

storage.candidate_bundle_retention: digest only; checkpoint bytes are not duplicated in the lineage ledger

limits: A completed lineage event proves that the host observed exact candidate bytes and identity after a pending promotion intent; it does not prove external input truth or general model equivalence.
The WASM branch receipt covers only the test vectors supplied to MultiInputVerificationCases.
The sidecar ledger is a host trust root; hashes are tamper-evident correlation values, not signatures or action authorization.
This checkpoint does not expose a JSON Lines branch-selection API and does not let the host choose among branches.
Pending events are intentionally preserved as indeterminate after crashes; they must never be interpreted as successful promotions.
